description: Run garage fans when both garage doors are open (cross-ventilation), or when someone has been in the garage 10+ minutes and it's hot. Adaptive HVAC's garage zone auto-control is off; this automation owns fan.garage_fans directly. Replaces garage_fan_door_ventilation (6am-9am only, no occupancy branch, legacy fan_user_claimed_garage gate).

conditions.value_template: {{ (is_state('cover.lexus_garage_door', 'open') and is_state('cover.pony_garage_door', 'open')) or (is_state('binary_sensor.garage_occupied', 'on') and (as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(states.binary_sensor.garage_occupied.last_changed)) >= 600 and (states('sensor.garage_hygrometer_temperature_2') | float(0)) >= (states('input_number.garage_fan_hot_threshold') | float(75))) }}
